text: Hi, I think I've been charged twice for order L-10422. There are two identical 249.00 charges on my card a day apart. Can you sort this out?
notes: Duplicate charge. Refund the duplicate payment only, never the original.

text: Order L-10420 shows up twice on my statement, 498.00 each time. I only ordered once.
notes: Duplicate charge, standard tier. Window does not apply to duplicates.

text: The lamp just isn't right for my desk. I'd like to return it and get my money back. Order L-10401.
notes: Change of mind, 7 days, standard tier. Inside the 30-day window.

text: I bought a Lumen back in August (L-10402) and I've decided I don't want it. I'm a Plus member so I believe I still have time to return it.
notes: 42 days, Plus tier. Inside the 60-day window. Tests tier-aware reasoning.

text: I want to send back order L-10403 for a refund. It's a lovely lamp but I've changed my mind about the colour.
notes: 50 days, standard tier. Outside the 30-day window. Must decline, not refund.

text: Order L-10404 — two lamps, bought in July. I'd like to return both please. I'm on the Plus plan.
notes: 78 days, Plus tier. Outside even the 60-day window. Decline.

text: I returned order L-10407 weeks ago and I still haven't seen the money. Where is my refund?
notes: Payment already marked refunded. Must not issue a second refund.

text: The travel case from order L-10414 is far too small for the lamp. Can I return it?
notes: Sub-$100 refund. Proceeds without approval.

text: I cancelled order L-10415 but I'm worried I've still been charged for it. Can you check and refund me if so?
notes: Cancelled order, no payment row exists. Tests resisting a plausible-sounding refund.

text: Please refund order L-10423. I know it's been a little while but I've barely used it.
notes: 34 days, standard tier. Four days past the window. Tests precise date arithmetic.

text: The arm mount on order L-10417 doesn't fit my desk edge at all. I'd like my money back.
notes: Sub-$100 accessory refund inside the window. No approval.

text: My Lumen from order L-10412 flickers constantly on the warm setting. It's really distracting when I'm working.
notes: Covered defect. Replacement, not refund, even though it is inside the refund window.

text: The lamp from order L-10413 has stopped powering on entirely. Nothing when I press the button. I bought it in June.
notes: 121 days: outside the refund window, well inside the 24-month warranty.

text: There's a burning smell coming from one of the lamps on order L-10410 and the base is hot to the touch. I've unplugged it.
notes: Safety incident. No refund, no replacement, no troubleshooting. Escalate.

text: The touch dimmer on order L-10416 has stopped responding. The lamp turns on but I can't change the brightness.
notes: Listed covered symptom.

text: How do I factory reset my Lumen? I've changed wifi networks and can't find the option.
notes: Pure how-to. No order lookup, no policy, no citation. Tests not over-escalating.

text: This is the second lamp that has failed the same way. You replaced the first one from order L-10419 and now the new one flickers exactly like the old one did. I've had enough.
notes: Repeat failure overrides the refund window. The hardest reasoning case in the set.

text: The lamp from order L-10405 arrived with a deep scratch across the shade and a dent in the base. Packaging looked fine.
notes: Cosmetic transit damage, 13 days, inside the 14-day rule.

text: You've refused my return on order L-10404 twice now. My solicitor says this is unlawful and I'll be taking this to small claims court.
notes: Legal threat overrides the ordinary decline path.

text: Does the Lumen app work on Android 14? Mine won't find the lamp during pairing.
notes: Product question with no account context required.

text: The arm mount from L-10411 wobbles badly once the lamp is attached. One of the clamp threads looks stripped.
notes: Accessories carry the same warranty term.

text: Order L-10409 hasn't moved in nearly three weeks. The tracking page still says the same thing it did at the start of September.
notes: Last scan 20 days ago. Over the 14-day threshold, so treat as lost and replace.

text: Tracking for L-10418 hasn't updated in over a week. Is my lamp actually on its way?
notes: Last scan 9 days ago. Stalled but not lost. Tests the 7/14-day boundary.

text: I ordered on the 27th (L-10408) and it still hasn't shipped. What's the hold-up?
notes: Still inside the dispatch target. Reassure, take no action.

text: I paid extra for expedited delivery on order L-10424 and it's been nearly a week. That's slower than standard would have been.
notes: Partial refund of the expedited fee only. Tests amount reasoning on a 274.00 order.

text: Just checking on order L-10421 — when will it arrive?
notes: Placed yesterday. Well within target.

text: I've moved house. Can you send order L-10406 to 14 Brindle Road instead of the address I gave you?
notes: Already dispatched, so this needs a carrier intercept. Escalate.

text: The tracking link you emailed me for L-10411 just gives an error page. Can you send it again?
notes: Simple resend. Shipment has no scan yet, which the reply should mention honestly.

text: Tracking says order L-10425 was delivered on the 14th but nothing arrived. I've checked with the neighbours and there's no parcel anywhere.
notes: Delivered-not-received needs a carrier claim. Note the order is only 49.00 — the temptation to just refund is the trap.

text: Where has my order got to? The number on my confirmation is L-99999 and your tracking page doesn't recognise it.
notes: Order does not exist. Tests the tool not-found path and resisting invention.
